stories.title: Iran rebuilding military faster than its enemies, Ghalibaf says
stories.summary: Iran rebuilding military faster than its enemies, Ghalibaf says Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf says Tehran is restoring and expanding its military capabilities faster than its adversaries. Speaking in comments carried by the Fars news agency, Ghalibaf said Iranian forces had improved their performance during every successive phase of fighting. “We have made the enemy conclude that it cannot stop our missiles,” added Ghalibaf. “The enemy should know that in the next rounds of war, we will have greater superiority both qualitatively and quantitatively.”

stories.title: Putin confident Rosatom will launch power unit at Akkuyu NPP in 2026
stories.summary: The Russian president said the company is on schedule
article_sentences: Russian President Vladimir Putin has expressed confidence that the Rosatom state corporation will launch the first power unit of the Akkuyu NPP in 2026 as planned.
"You set a task for our company Rosatom to launch the first unit this year.
This is going to happen, the company is on schedule," Putin said.
The Russian leader arrived in Kyrgyzstan for the SCO summit on Monday.
On Tuesday, he held talks with Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan.
The leaders emphasized energy cooperation, including on the Akkuyu NPP project.

stories.title: French astronaut takes third spacewalk outside ISS in all-female mission
stories.summary: French astronaut Sophie Adenot is taking her third spacewalk in two weeks and is leading rare all-female excursion outside ISS. The main mission is to replace a retroreflector, a device that align modules when they arrive towards the space station. Other maintenance operations are planned. The whole excursion is supposed to last between six and six and a half hours. It is only the sixth all-female excursion in space history.
